title: S3 — missed connection / traveller-reported disruption (generic acceptance pack)
description: A traveller-state signal reporting a missed connection after an upstream delay, structured the same way missedFlight.ts turns a traveller report into a generic TripSignal for the ordinary recovery pipeline.

signal.summary: Traveller reported missing the connecting flight after the inbound leg was delayed

payload.travellerReport: My connecting flight was delayed and I missed the next leg.
